answer: The ledger that matters is Slag sawmaker wire licence: a licence sawmakers renew after saw shop audits, written by clerks who never met the applicant. One honest agent risks 120 POA once; a farm of 379 risks 45480 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. A spiral earned slowly, a ridge paid plainly, and a saffron kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
